stem.text: Which graph could show how the resistance $R$ of a filament lamp varies with the applied potential difference (p.d.) $V$, as $V$ is increased to the normal operating p.d.?

A.alt: Graph of resistance R against potential difference V, with a straight line starting above the origin.

B.alt: Graph of resistance R against potential difference V, with a curve starting at the origin and levelling off.

C.alt: Graph of resistance R against potential difference V, with a horizontal line.

D.alt: Graph of resistance R against potential difference V, with a curve falling from the R axis and levelling off.
